english.title: Distributor fail to pass on information on the risks posed by a product
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a distributor, in failing to act with due care in order to help ensure compliance with the applicable safety requirements, failed, within the limits of your activities, to participate in monitoring the safety of a product placed on the market, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), in that you did not pass on information on the risks posed by the product
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8(1)(b)(i) and 20(2) of the General Product Safety Regulations 2005.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
A magistrates' court may try an information in respect of an offence under these Regulations if the information is laid within three years from the date of the offence or within one year from the discovery of the offence by the prosecutor whichever is the earlier (regulation 41).

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
